text.id: Laporan penculikannya ditarik siang itu juga. "Salah paham," kata kuasa hukum PT Bentang di TV. Pak Hendra pulang naik kapalnya sendiri, nggak ngomong sepatah kata pun sepanjang jalan.
text.en: The kidnapping report is withdrawn that same afternoon. "A misunderstanding," PT Bentang's lawyer says on TV. Pak Hendra goes home on his own boat, without a word the whole way.

text.id: Dua hari kemudian, Pak Darmawan narik semua omongannya. Dia bilang dia nggak pernah naik kapal itu. Rekaman tanpa narsum cuma suara orang asing di tengah laut.
text.en: Two days later, Pak Darmawan takes back everything he said. He says he was never on that boat. A recording without its source is just a stranger's voice at sea.

text.id: Dua hari kemudian, narsumnya narik semua omongannya. Dia bilang dia nggak pernah naik kapal itu. Rekaman tanpa narsum cuma suara orang asing di tengah laut.
text.en: Two days later, the source takes back everything he said. He says he was never on that boat. A recording without its source is just a stranger's voice at sea.

text.id: Pak Hendra pulang ke Muara Angke dengan nama bersih. Sekar nggak pulang. Nggak ada yang tahu perahu nelayan pagi itu ke mana, dan Pak Hendra nggak mau bilang. Ke siapa pun. Termasuk gue.
text.en: Pak Hendra goes home to Muara Angke with his name cleared. Sekar doesn't come home. Nobody knows where that fishing boat went that morning, and Pak Hendra won't say. To anyone. Including me.

caption.id: Air surut di Muara Angke. Patok-patoknya kelihatan sampai ke ujung.
caption.en: Low tide at Muara Angke. You can see the stakes all the way out.

text.id: Ipda Yusuf nyimpen ancaman Didit di berkas. Didit dipanggil dua kali, terus dipindah ke Surabaya. Ancaman doang nggak bikin izin dicabut.
text.en: Inspector Yusuf kept Didit's threat on file. Didit was called in twice, then transferred to Surabaya. A threat alone doesn't get a permit pulled.

text.id: Ada orang deket gue yang ngebocorin, Ka. Gue nggak bakal pernah tahu siapa.
text.en: Someone close to me leaked it, Ka. I'll never know who.

text.id: Lo udah ngomong lebih banyak minggu ini daripada lima tahun kemarin. Jangan dipaksain.
text.en: You've talked more this week than in the last five years. Don't push it.

text.id: Kita duduk di perahu terbalik, ngelihatin patok-patok sampai airnya naik lagi. Nggak ngomong apa-apa. Kali ini diemnya bukan kabur.
text.en: We sit on an upturned boat, watching the stakes until the water comes back in. Saying nothing. This time the quiet isn't running away.

text.id: Gue duduk di perahu terbalik, ngelihatin patok-patok sampai airnya naik lagi. Jejaknya ilang di situ. Di antara patok.
text.en: I sit on an upturned boat, watching the stakes until the water comes back in. The trail ends there. Somewhere among the stakes.

summary.id: Nama Pak Hendra bersih, tapi jejak ke izin itu hilang. Patok-patoknya tetap berdiri, dan kelihatan jelas setiap air surut.
summary.en: Pak Hendra's name was cleared, but the trail to the permit went cold. The stakes are still standing, plain to see at every low tide.
